email.body1:
Erin, saw Kinective licensed Gateway to PayNearMe and shipped the new SignPlus Gateway enhancements this spring.

More ecosystem activity usually means more buying signals than the team can action before they go stale, and that latency quietly caps pipeline. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized outreach automatically: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

I built a signal play for Kinective off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Erin, quick follow-up for Kinective.

Most RevOps teams lose pipeline in the lag between a signal firing and a rep actually touching the account. Tightening that loop is usually a bigger lever than more headcount, and our best practices alone lift response rates 50-70%.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change, and how to cut signal-to-action latency without adding reps.
email.body3:
Erin, last bit of proof for Kinective.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Kinective's reply rate likely compares to other fintech platforms. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?

Erin, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion? I'll tailor it to Kinective either way.
